mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a current temperature of 66 degrees, feeling like 69.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to honor the expertise the Planning and Development Department brings to our city. Also, please keep an eye out for upcoming mail regarding mandatory cross connection control surveys to help keep our water supply clean.

It is a busy couple of days in town. Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy happy hour at ART House 360, or join trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at recent reports, on September 14, officers performed a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a 37-year-old Verona man for probation violations and other traffic-related offences.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain serving guests until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon to get your fix.
